mapper.select: select DIS_ID id, DIS_NAME text from DIS_PRAMS

select distinct PROD_ID id, PROD_NAME text from REP_PROD_INFO where STATUS='E'
and (PROD_ID like '%' || #{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' or PROD_NAME like '%' || #{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
and p_prod_id is null
and p_prod_id is not null

select distinct RPI.P_PROD_ID id, RPI.PROD_ABBR text from REP_PROD_INFO RPI
inner join DIS_PROD_FEEDISCOUNT DPF on DPF.PROD_REGIST_NO=RPI.PROD_RE and DPF.DATA_STATUS='01'
inner join DIS_PROD_ADJUST DPA on DPA.PROD_REGIST_NO=RPI.PROD_RE and DPA.DATA_STATUS='01'
inner join DIS_LARGE_REDEMPTION DLR on DLR.PROD_REGIST_NO=RPI.PROD_RE and DLR.STATUS='01'
where RPI.STATUS='E' and rep_prod_type in ('01','02')
and (RPI.P_PROD_ID like '%' || #{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' or RPI.PROD_ABBR like '%' || #{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
${condition}
